title: Ham & Prosciutto Sliders
summary: Baked sweet-roll sliders, portioned and rebalanced. The rolls and cheese set a floor on the fat here, so this is the treat item of the group rather than a macro workhorse, but at 41g protein per serving it earns its place. Three sliders per serving.

ingredients.raw: 18 oz (2 packs) lower sodium honey ham, 1.5 oz per slider
9 oz (1 pack) lower sodium honey ham, 0.75 oz per slider
9 oz deli chicken breast, 0.75 oz per slider
~6 slices prosciutto (1 pack covers it), half a slice per slider
~3 slices prosciutto, a quarter slice per slider
12 slices sharp aged white cheddar (~4 oz total), one thin slice per slider, ~1/3 oz
Garlic powder, salt, and a squeeze of lime, for the sauce

steps.body: Halve the prosciutto slices (half a slice per slider).
Quarter the prosciutto slices (a quarter slice per slider).
Slice the avocado, but don't add it yet, since heat turns it bitter and brown.

Halve the avocado. Slice one half, and blend the other into the cottage cheese with garlic powder, salt, and lime so it reads as a creamy sauce. Don't add either yet, since heat turns avocado bitter and brown.
Layer the ham, prosciutto, cheddar, onion, and jalapeño in the rolls.
Layer the ham, chicken, prosciutto, cheddar, onion, and jalapeño in the rolls.
Bake **8–10 minutes**, until the cheese melts and the rolls are warmed through.
**Add the avocado after baking**, sliced or mashed.
**Add the avocado and the cottage cheese sauce after baking.**

notes.body: Strong protein, but 26g fat is a third of a 75g day in one meal. Plan a leaner day around it, or pick the leaner build in the table.

Three swaps stacked: split the meat between ham and deli chicken, cut the prosciutto in half, and blend half the avocado into cottage cheese as a sauce. That saves ~5g fat, adds ~3g protein, and cuts sodium ~15% per serving.
**Ham is the base, prosciutto is the accent.** Prosciutto runs ~2x the fat of ham per ounce and drives the sodium, so a half slice per slider gives the cured punch without the cost
**One slice of cheese, not two.** Aged sharp cheddar reads plenty at 1/3 oz. Double-layering cheese is the easiest place to accidentally add 5g fat per slider
**Avocado over mayo.** Same creamy role, but monounsaturated fat and fiber instead of 10g fat per tbsp with nothing else
**Load the onion and jalapeño** for flavor and volume at no calorie cost
